overview_description.description: Smarking is a group of MIT PhDs, stellar software engineers, and seasoned business professionals who set out on a journey to bring cutting edge solutions to the parking world. Frustrated that unlike many other industries, the $100 billion park industry (worldwide) still doesn’t have state of the art data analytics or yield management technologies, they are passionate about pushing the industry forward. In a short eighteen-month period, Smarking has attracted a tremendous amount of customers and grown their team into one with experts from both parking and tech. With great passion and continuous innovation, they are working on the frontier of the parking industry, shaping a bright future together with their customers.

about_short_description.short_description: Smarking is an information technology company that provides business intelligence and yield management solutions.

product.name: Business Intelligence
product.description: A platform that centralizes parking data to help users make data-driven decisions, track real-time occupancy, revenue, and transactions, and receive automatic projections and alerts.

product.name: Dynamic Pricing
product.description: Adjusts parking rates in real-time based on market demand to help maximize revenue, supported by data analysis and recommendations.

product.name: Parking Data Enterprise Cloud
product.description: Provides a centralized platform for data integration, cloud hosting, and data streaming, supporting direct integration with various parking systems and applications.

product.name: Automated Yield Management (AYM)
product.description: A service offered for free for a limited time to automate dynamic pricing and increase revenue without the need for additional hardware.

product.name: SmartPass
product.description: A service that allows users to purchase parking passes online for easy and secure parking at various locations.
